title: TAP Plugin Data Directory Description
description: The `.tap-plugin-dir.json` file core writes at the top of every plugin data directory (tap_plugins/specs/spec-tap-plugin-data-directory.md, req-tap-plugin-datadir-provision). Its purpose is that a directory found on a volume, with no instance running, says what it is — above all its durability, which a future backup needs (req-tap-plugin-datadir-backup-facts). Written by core, rewritten when the declaration changes, and validated against this schema whenever it is read.

format_version.description: Version of this file's format. 1 for the first release.

slug.description: The plugin slug the directory is named after.

durability.description: `cache`: everything can be fetched or rebuilt. `state`: something cannot be rebuilt and must survive.

purpose.description: The plugin's one-sentence statement of what it keeps there.

max_bytes.description: The largest size the plugin's author expects the directory to reach. Recorded, not enforced.

executes.description: Whether the plugin declared that it runs programs from the directory.

location.description: `volume`: on the operator's plugin data volume. `ephemeral`: under core's ephemeral root, lost when the container is recreated.

created_by_plugin_version.description: The plugin version that first caused the directory to be created.

created_at.description: When core created the directory, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.
